### Inputs

```{ojs}
viewof drift = Inputs.range([-300, 300], {value: 0, step: 5, label: "Generic yield drift (bp / year)"})
viewof vol = Inputs.range([20, 250], {value: 83, step: 1, label: "Generic yield vol (bp / year)"})
viewof nScen = Inputs.select([2000, 5000, 10000, 20000], {value: 10000, label: "Scenarios"})
```

```{ojs}
html`<p class="small text-muted">Daily vol ≈ ${(vol / Math.sqrt(252)).toFixed(1)} bp.
To delivery: mean ${(drift * model.T).toFixed(0)} bp, s.d. ${(vol * Math.sqrt(model.T)).toFixed(0)} bp
(${(model.T * 365.25).toFixed(0)} days).</p>`
```

#### Contract

```{ojs}
viewof asOf = Inputs.text({value: "2026-10-28", label: "Analysis date"})
viewof delivery = Inputs.text({value: "2026-12-31", label: "Delivery date"})
viewof roundMonths = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Quarters (TY, US, UB)", 3], ["Months (TU, Z3N, FV)", 1]]), {value: 3, label: "CF term rounding"})
```

#### Deliverable basket

::: {.small .text-muted}
One bond per line: `name, coupon %, maturity, yield %, beta to generic`.
:::

```{ojs}
viewof basketText = Inputs.textarea({
  value: `T 4 1/4 06/30/33, 4.25, 2033-06-30, 4.934, 0.99
T 4 3/8 07/31/33, 4.375, 2033-07-31, 4.938, 1.00
T 3 7/8 08/15/33, 3.875, 2033-08-15, 4.940, 1.00
T 4 1/2 08/31/33, 4.5, 2033-08-31, 4.942, 1.00
T 5 09/30/33, 5.0, 2033-09-30, 4.946, 1.00
T 4 1/2 11/15/33, 4.5, 2033-11-15, 4.952, 1.00
T 4 02/15/34, 4.0, 2034-02-15, 4.960, 1.00
T 4 3/8 05/15/34, 4.375, 2034-05-15, 4.968, 1.00
T 3 7/8 08/15/34, 3.875, 2034-08-15, 4.977, 1.00
T 4 1/4 11/15/34, 4.25, 2034-11-15, 4.985, 1.00`,
  rows: 12,
  submit: "Update basket",
  spellcheck: false
})
```

::: {.small .text-muted}
Default: TY (10-year T-note) December 2026 (TYZ6), as of 28 Oct 2026.
Basket: every 7- and 10-year note with 6½ to 8 years left to maturity from 1 Dec 2026
(coupons from [TreasuryDirect](https://www.treasurydirect.gov/auctions/auction-query/)). The 7-year notes auctioned in late October and November 2026
are not included: their coupons are not yet known.
Yields: the [Treasury par curve](https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve&field_tdr_date_value=2026)
interpolated at each maturity. Betas and vol: 65-day daily changes against the 10-year par yield.
These are approximations of each note's own market yield, so replace them with quotes for trading use.
:::

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-9}

```{ojs}
model = {
  const d = parseDate(delivery);
  return setup({
    basket: parseBasket(basketText),
    analysisDate: parseDate(asOf),
    deliveryDate: d,
    firstDeliveryDay: new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), d.getUTCMonth(), 1)),
    roundMonths
  });
}
W = normals(nScen, 1)
params = ({drift: drift / 10000, vol: vol / 10000})
run = simulate(model, W, {...params, keepScenarios: true})
names = model.bonds.map(b => b.name)
ctd = model.bonds[model.ctd0]
oaDV01 = optionAdjustedDV01(model, W, params) * 1000
ctdDV01 = ctd.beta * ctd.dv01 / ctd.cf * 1000
pSwitch = 1 - run.prob[model.ctd0]
```

```{ojs}
tile = (label, value, note) => html`<div><div class="border rounded p-2 h-100">
  <div class="small text-muted">${label}</div>
  <div class="fs-4 fw-semibold">${value}</div>
  <div class="small text-muted">${note}</div></div></div>`

html`<div class="mb-3" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 0.5rem;">
  ${tile("Current CTD", ctd.name, `price / CF ${ctd.f0.toFixed(3)}`)}
  ${tile("P(CTD switch)", `${(pSwitch * 100).toFixed(1)}%`, "by delivery")}
  ${tile("Option-adj. DV01", `$${oaDV01.toFixed(1)}`, "per contract, per bp")}
  ${tile("CTD DV01 / CF", `$${ctdDV01.toFixed(1)}`, `β-weighted · gap ${(oaDV01 - ctdDV01 >= 0 ? "+" : "")}${(oaDV01 - ctdDV01).toFixed(1)}`)}
</div>`
```

#### How the answer changes with today's yield level

```{ojs}
shifts = d3.range(-200, 301, 10)
grid = sweep(model, W.slice(0, 2000), params, shifts)
```

      Plot.pointer({x: "shift", y: "prob", title: d => `${d.bond}\n${d.shift >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${d.shift} bp: ${(d.prob * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}))
  ]
})

:::

::: {.small .text-muted}
Each point re-runs the model with today's generic yield shifted (every bond moves by β × shift),
using 2,000 scenarios. When a CTD switch is likely, the futures DV01 departs from the current CTD's DV01 / CF,
so hedge ratios based on the CTD alone over- or under-hedge.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Methodology

1. **Scenarios.** The generic yield follows Brownian motion with drift:
   Δy<sup>g</sup> = μT + σ√T · W, W ~ N(0, 1), where T is the time to delivery.
2. **Bond yields at delivery.** Each deliverable moves with its beta: y<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> = y<sub>0</sub><sup>i</sup> + β<sup>i</sup> · Δy<sup>g</sup>.
3. **CTD.** Clean prices P<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> are computed for settlement on the delivery date; the bond with the
   lowest P<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> / CF<sup>i</sup> is the CTD in that scenario. CTD probability = share of scenarios.
4. **Net basis fair value.** In each scenario the futures price is F<sub>T</sub> = min<sub>i</sub> P<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> / CF<sup>i</sup> and the basis
   is B<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> = P<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup> − F<sub>T</sub> · CF<sup>i</sup>. The fair value of the net basis is the average B<sub>T</sub><sup>i</sup>
   across scenarios, since a long net basis position converges to the basis at delivery.
5. **Option-adjusted DV01.** The change in expected futures price E[F<sub>T</sub>] for a 1 bp shift in today's generic
   yield (central difference with the same random draws), × $1,000 per point for a $100k contract.

Conversion factors use the CME formula (6% notional coupon, term rounded down to quarters or months from
the first day of the delivery month). Simplifications: a single delivery date (the timing, end-of-month and
wild-card options are ignored), today's yields are used as the expected yields at delivery unless a drift is set,
and the curve moves through one factor.
:::
